criteria.name: Modularity & Cohesion
criteria.peerPreText: Which design is more modular and cohesive?
criteria.selfPreText: Rate the modularity and cohesion of your group's submission.
criteria.postText: Consider whether each package does one cohesive thing, and whether functionality is spread across multiple packages.

taRubric.text: All code in a single package

criteria.name: Decoupling
criteria.selfPreText: Rate the decoupling of your group's submission.
criteria.postText: Consider the number of imports between packages and whether interfaces were used to reduce coupling.

taRubric.text: All code in a single package
HTTP and data handling in same package
HTTP and data handling fully decoupled

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.selfPreText: Rate the clarity of your group's implementation.
criteria.postText: Consider whether the code is easy to understand, whether names are clear, and whether documentation is present.
criteria.postTextTa: Focus on missing or misleading doc comments.

criteria.name: Robustness
criteria.peerPreText: Which design has better error handling?
criteria.selfPreText: Rate the quality of the error handling in your group's submission.
criteria.postText: Are errors always handled? Are all errors logged? Would any errors crash the system?

taRubric.text: More than half of fallible calls lack error checks
